body:
my heart when Taylor gets to just be a fan of someone else's record 🥹

awards season for "I Knew It, I Knew You," her song for Toy Story 5, put her at a press conference for Golden Globe voters, and she used it to shout out two albums: Rosalía's LUX and Olivia Dean's The Art of Loving.

she called LUX conceptual, ambitious, expansive and perfect, and compared The Art of Loving to a warm hug. her point was that both land because people made them.

send this to the friend who had either one on repeat this year.
